lines.text: Hey everyone LeBooBoo here. Today on LeBooMax our planned interview with a vampire had to be cancelled last minute due to filming issues. Turns out those guys don’t exactly show up on camera…

So instead, check this out, we’ve got an interview with two voice actors from the upcoming MinnHax game “The Department of Parasocial Activity”. They have been working all month, so let’s kick things off with some introductions. First up, we have what looks like a horse wrapped in dollar bills?
Me?
You!
Hi, my name is Yu. In the game, I do the voice acting for a character called “MoneyPony”. She helps Agent Forty complete his mission to stop LeBooBoo.

Great to meet you Yu. I should say - for the audience - I also play a role in the game as a rapper called LeBooBoo - a sort of “elusive target” if you will. I’ll get back to you, but next, let’s hear from a man with a very round bald head, and - is that a QR code?

Hi! Ya, this QR code is just my character's name “Agent Forty-JeffM”. My real life name is Richard, and I’m the developer for the game, and the voice actor for Agent Forty-JeffM, and myself I guess, and you.
and Yu?
No you! LeBooBoo, I’m your voice actor.
Em, well I don’t know about that... but anyways question for Yu what made you want to take part in this project. This game.
Oh ah, Richard and I were walking at the start of November, and he was planning to have voice acting in the game. He asked me if I wanted to voice a character called TCB, and I said -
TCB? Does that stand for something?

TCB stands for “Tough Chubby Boy” - haha. It’s a character we joke about sometimes. Richard said we could put a Tough Chubby Boy in the game. Then, we decided it would be fun if I voiced MonyPony as well. So, I was excited to try.
You’ve never voice acted before?
No, just trying it for fun mostly.
Awesome! Well, I can’t wait to encounter TCB in the game.
Haha - sounds good.

Question for Richard - the game has parasocial in its name, and, from what I understand, deals with some parasocial themes as well. As the developer, what made you decide to take things in that direction?

Good question! I feel like “parasocialism” is getting more attention recently. There was a panel about it at PAX West, which I attended. The lines between creator and audience are getting blurred as more people become creators.
So, I’ve been reflecting more on my relationship with content, and when I make games, I end up drawing from whatever I’m thinking about, so that’s how these themes made it into the game.
Thanks for that answer. That just about does it for our interview. And it looks like a bonus guest just jumped onto the desk.
Meow!
And with that join me online tomorrow morning! I will be streaming “The Department of Parasocial Activity”. And Yu, I know you watch this show: LeBooMax, so would you like to take us out?
Sure… Be Boo’d, get scared… and bye suckers!
haha - See ya tomorrow folks!
Great interview yesterday. Right lil’ Boo?
Look at that. Almost time to kick off the stream.
